subject: Java Programming
text: What is the primary role of the Java Virtual Machine (JVM)?
explanation: The JVM loads and executes Java bytecode, providing the runtime environment for Java applications.

subject: Java Programming
text: Which Java keyword declares that a class inherits from another class?
explanation: A class uses extends to inherit from another class; implements is used for interfaces.

subject: Java Programming
text: Which change creates a valid overloaded method in Java?
explanation: Overloaded methods share a name but have different parameter lists, such as different parameter types or counts.

subject: Java Programming
text: When does method overriding occur in Java?
optionA: When a subclass provides an implementation with a compatible signature for an inherited instance method
optionB: When two methods differ only by return type
optionC: When a constructor is called twice
optionD: When a field is declared static
explanation: Overriding lets a subclass provide its own implementation of an inherited method using a compatible method signature.

subject: Java Programming
text: Which keyword does a Java class use to implement an interface?
explanation: A class declares the interfaces it implements with the implements keyword.

subject: Java Programming
text: Which block handles an exception thrown from a corresponding try block?
explanation: A catch block handles an exception matching its declared type that is thrown while executing the try block.

subject: Java Programming
text: Which Java collection class provides a resizable array implementation of the List interface?
explanation: ArrayList implements List using a dynamically resizable array.

subject: Java Programming
text: Under normal control flow, when is a finally block executed?
optionB: Only when an exception is caught
optionC: After the try/catch processing whether or not an exception was thrown
explanation: A finally block normally runs after try/catch processing, making it useful for cleanup regardless of whether an exception occurred.

subject: Java Programming
text: Which call asks the Java runtime to schedule a new Thread for execution?
explanation: Calling start() begins a new thread of execution and the runtime invokes its run() method on that thread.

subject: Java Programming
text: Which Java class is designed to read raw bytes from a file?
explanation: FileInputStream is a byte stream for reading raw file bytes; Reader classes are intended for character data.
